text:
anya (People Ops): Quick ask — launching a compact 'manager self-review' one-pager for folks who hate essays. Draft below, pls react/suggest. Need this in templates by EOD Thurs.
devon (eng manager): Love the idea. Can we add one line for peer signals / upward feedback?
samir (backend): +1. Also include a single '1-line impact' and a measurable metric line: `Metric: X -> Y`
peggy (people partner): For ICs, drop the "people management" row. Recommend publishing two tiny variants (IC vs manager).
anya (People Ops): Yep — will split. Draft compact template (paste for copy):
```
1) 1-line impact (what changed because of your work)
2) Top 3 achievements (one-line bullets)
3) Signal(s) of success / Metric: name — before -> after
4) Area(s) of focus next cycle
5) Manager-only: team growth / direct-report examples (if applicable)
6) Asks / blockers from company (tools, policy, headcount)
```
devon (eng manager): Suggest changing 'Metric' to 'Signal(s) of success' — keeps it flexible for non-product metrics.
okrbuddy-bot: :bell: Reminder — self-reviews due 2026-04-10 23:59 UTC. Submit at https://redwood/reviews
anya (People Ops): Final tweak applied (swapped Metric -> Signal). Uploaded to /handbook/templates/self-review-onepager and created two files (IC + manager). Will ping docs for a quick link in the cycle announcement. Thanks all :tada:
